name: camayoc_work_item_usage_records
description: Q16 request evidence by model and harness, with disjoint counts. Missing fields remain unbound, never zero. This is observed coverage, not proof of lifetime completeness.
template: PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?record ?session ?tokens ?model ?harness ?input ?cacheRead ?cacheWrite ?output WHERE { ?record a a:UsageRecord ; a:attributedTo <{workitem}> ; a:inSession ?session ; a:tokensConsumed ?tokens . OPTIONAL { ?record a:usageModel ?model } OPTIONAL { ?record a:usageHarness ?harness } OPTIONAL { ?record a:inputTokensUncached ?input } OPTIONAL { ?record a:cacheReadInputTokens ?cacheRead } OPTIONAL { ?record a:cacheWriteInputTokens ?cacheWrite } OPTIONAL { ?record a:outputTokens ?output } }
